{{Quote|Music."<br />"If you're from Tatooine, maybe. The rest of us would call that a rancor belch.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]]|<ref name="Joiner">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>}}
[[File:BithBand.jpg|250px|thumb|[[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], [[Pacithhip/Legends|Pacithhip]], and [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] musicians at the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
'''Music''' played an important role in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], giving artists the means to express themselves through sound waves. As galactic civilization spanned thousands of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] and [[Species/Legends|cultures]], the variance in music of the galaxy was considerable, as was its role in different cultures. Even [[Droid/Legends|mechanicals]] were involved in the production of music; droids that were programmed to play music were called [[musician droid]]s.

A vastly popular and galaxy-spanning type of music during the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]]. A popular jizz group in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] was [[Figrin D'an/Legends|Figrin D'an]] and the [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]].
